svg.title: A hash table keeps empty space on purpose
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “A hash table keeps empty space on purpose” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A whiteboard sketch showing four hash buckets with the keys ann, bob and cy hashed and masked into them and the arithmetic written out; a fourth key dee colliding and being hung off a bucket as a chain at 1.15 probes; the same collision resolved by open addressing with numbered probes walking right two occupied slots before landing in a free one; a resize where the four-bucket table is crossed out in red and every key is redrawn into an eight-bucket table because the mask changed; and a plot of average probes against load factor where chaining stays nearly flat from 1.15 to 1.50 while open addressing climbs from 1.22 to 40.99, with a worst observed probe count of 15,832.
svg.text: A hash table keeps empty space on purpose
draw it from memory, then compare
